# Isaiah Chapter 19 -- The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full dynamic translation of all 25 verses in natural contemporary English]*

*LORD rides cloud to Egypt; civil war; Nile dries; future blessing — Egypt, Assyria, Israel together*

---

## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

**Oracle Against Egypt:** LORD rides cloud to Egypt; civil war; Nile dries; future blessing — Egypt, Assyria, Israel together. The key message for modern readers: "In that day there will be an altar to the LORD in the midst of the land of Egypt"

*-- PNEUMA*
